_comment: Exact git refs (tag or SHA) of pine-lang and beamlynx-ui bundled into this desktop build. Checked out directly by CI via these refs -- update deliberately as part of a release, per RELEASING.md. pine-lang unchanged at its tagged 0.51.0; beamlynx-ui bumped to its tagged 0.70.0 for sign-in at each launch, Account at the bottom of the sidebar and opening a connection in a new tab. beamlynx-ui 0.70.0 still needs pine-lang 0.51 (its RequiredVersion).
